translations.text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to you who are beloved by God the Father and kept by Christ Jesus:
May mercy be with you, and may peace and love be multiplied!
Beloved, I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation. I found it necessary to write to you. I beg you to strive for the faith that was given to the saints once for all.
For certain men have crept in who were written down long ago for this judgment. They are ungodly men who turn the grace of our God into impurity and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
I want to remind you, though you know all things, that God once saved the people out of Egypt, but the second time destroyed those who were disobedient.
The angels who did not keep their own dominion but abandoned their dwelling he has kept under darkness in everlasting bonds for the judgment of the great day,

just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them did. In the same way as these, they committed fornication and pursued strange flesh. They lie before us as an example of eternal fire, having received punishment.
In the same way these men also see visions: they defile the flesh, despise lordship, and blaspheme glory.

When Michael the archangel was contending with the devil and speaking with him about the body of Moses, he did not dare to bring a blasphemous judgment against him, but said: “May the Lord rebuke you.”
But these men, the things they do not know with the understanding, like brute beasts, in these things they are corrupted.
Woe to them! For they walk in the way of Cain, they have plunged into the error of Balaam for reward, and they have perished in the rebellion of Korah.

These are the ones who feast with you at your love-feasts, being defiled, and shepherd themselves without fear. They are waterless clouds swept about by the wind, wintry trees without fruit, twice dead, pulled up by the roots,
raging waves of the sea that foam up their own shame, wandering stars for whom the gloom of darkness has been kept forever.
Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about them and said: “Behold, the Lord has come with myriads of his holy angels
to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all the ungodly deeds by which they sinned, and of all the harsh words that ungodly sinners spoke against him.”
These are grumblers and complainers who walk according to their own desires. Their mouths speak arrogant things, and they show regard for persons for the sake of gain.
But you, beloved, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
For they told you that in the last times scoffers would come, walking according to their own ungodly desires.
These are the ones who set themselves apart. They are worldly and do not have the Spirit.
But you, beloved, build yourselves up in your most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit.
Keep yourselves in the love of God, and wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to eternal life.
And have mercy on some who are in doubt.
Some you should save, snatching them as if from fire; on others have mercy with fear. Hate even the garment defiled by the flesh.
Now to him who is able to keep you without sin and to set you blameless before his glory with joy,
to the only God, our Saviour, through Christ Jesus our Lord, be glory and riches, strength and authority, before all ages, and now, and for all times, forever and ever. Amen.
